title: French Tofu Gratin
description: A rich and creamy French-inspired dish, made entirely with plant-based ingredients.

ingredients.name: bitter leaves
ingredients.notes: such as kale or collard greens

instructions: Grease a baking dish with olive oil.
Arrange a layer of cubed bread at the bottom of the dish.
Top the bread with a layer of cubed tofu.
Drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with gratin.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of bread on top.
Transfer the dish to the oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with bitter leaves and serve hot.
Optional: broil for an additional 2-3 minutes to achieve a crispy top.
